business_summary: CSPC Pharmaceutical Group Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the manufacture and sale of pharmaceutical products in Mainland China, other Asian regions, Europe, North America, and internationally. It operates through Finished Drugs, Bulk Products, and Functional Food and Others segments. The company provides NBP soft capsules and injections for acute ischemic stroke; Oulaining capsules and injections to treat mild to moderate memory and mental impairment; Enxi to treat adult idiopathic Parkinson's disease; Duomeisu for lymphoma, multiple myeloma, ovarian and breast cancers, and other malignant tumors; Jinyouli to prevent infection induced by chemotherapy; and Keaili for breast cancer. It also offers Shuluoke, Nuomoling, Weihong, and Xinweihong for various infections; Xuanning for hypertension; Encun to prevent atherosclerotic thrombosis events; Qixiao to treat upper respiratory tract infection; Linmeixin and Shuanglexin for diabetes; Gubang and Gubangjia to treat osteoporosis in postmenopausal women; and Gaoshunsong for arthritis, osteoarthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, frozen shoulder, bursuitis, tenosynovitis, acute gout, dysmenorrhea, toothache and postoperative pain, low back pain, sprain, strain, and other soft tissue injuries. In addition, the company provides Debixin for various ulcer; Qimaite for acute and chronic pains; antibiotics, vitamin C, and caffeine APIs; functional food products; and healthcare services. It has a strategic collaboration with AstraZeneca PLC to advance the discovery and development of novel oral candidates, with the potential to treat diseases across multiple indications and multiple therapies for obesity and type 2 diabetes. The company was formerly known as China Pharmaceutical Group Limited and changed its name to CSPC Pharmaceutical Group Limited in March 2013. CSPC Pharmaceutical Group Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is headquartered in Shijiazhuang, the People's Republic of China.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 CSPC Pharmaceutical Group Limited는 중국 본토, 기타 아시아 지역, 유럽, 북미 및 국제적으로 의약품의 제조 및 판매에 종사하고 있습니다. 완제품, 벌크 제품, 기능성 식품 및 기타 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 이 회사는 급성 허혈성 뇌졸중을 위한 NBP 연질캡슐과 주사제를 제공합니다. 경도에서 중등도의 기억력 및 정신 장애를 치료하기 위한 캡슐 및 주사제; 성인 특발성 파킨슨병을 치료하는 Enxi; 림프종, 다발성 골수종, 난소암, 유방암 및 기타 악성 종양에 대한 두오메이수; 화학 요법으로 인한 감염을 예방하는 진유리; 유방암에 대한 Keaili. 또한 다양한 감염에 대해 Shuluoke, Nuomoling, Weihong 및 Xinweihong을 제공합니다. 고혈압에 대한 Xuanning; 죽상동맥경화성 혈전증을 예방하기 위한 엔쿤(Encun); 상부 호흡기 감염을 치료하는 Qixiao; 당뇨병을 위한 Linmeixin 및 Shuanglexin; 폐경기 여성의 골다공증 치료에 구방과 구방지아; 관절염, 골관절염, 강직성 척추염, 오십견, 활액낭염, 건초염, 급성 통풍, 월경통, 치통 및 수술 후 치료에 대한 고순송
